label.purpose: Form field labels, above the input.

wordmark.purpose: The literal "Gavi411" logo text only, in Google Sans — never used for page headings.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — cards and the confirm modal. Darkens in dark mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-pill gold CTA, the general-purpose primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 28px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #f2a900; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #d99400; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(242,169,0,0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #f2a900; border: 1px solid rgba(242,169,0,0.4); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(242,169,0,0.12); }

components.name: Success Button
components.description: Sage-green fill, reserved for the intake flow's Submit action only.
components.css: .ds-btn-success { background: #6fae8f; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-success:hover { background: #4f8a6c; }

components.name: Purple Ghost Button
components.description: Lavender outline button, reserved for the intake flow's Back action only.
components.css: .ds-btn-purple { background: transparent; color: #9b8cce; border: 1px solid #9b8cce; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-purple:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #9b8cce 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface container, 20px radius, hairline border, ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ece8dc; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; text-align: start; box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 10px 15px -3px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0 4px 6px -2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labeled text input, 20px radius (not a pill), gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; text-align: start; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #221f19; } .ds-field-input { font-size: 16px; color: #221f19; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ece8dc; border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px 20px; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(242,169,0,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242,169,0,0.12); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped selectable chip, solid gold fill when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #221f19; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ece8dc; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(242,169,0,0.4); } .ds-chip-selected { background: #f2a900; color: #ffffff; border-color: #f2a900; }

components.name: Message Bubble (own)
components.description: Right-aligned gold chat bubble with an asymmetric pinched corner pointing toward the sender.
components.html: On my way, ETA 20 min
components.css: .ds-msg-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 80%; } .ds-msg-own { align-self: flex-end; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-msg-own .ds-msg-bubble { background: #f2a900; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px 20px 4px 20px; padding: 8px 12px; word-break: break-word; }

narrative.overview: Gavi411 reads like a trusted assistant's warm, well-kept ledger rather than a slick SaaS dashboard: a cream page, ink-dark text, white index cards for every request and message, and a confident gold accent for the actions that matter. Sage green and a soft lavender sit alongside gold as secondary/data accents — a chat bubble, a "Submit" vs. "Back" distinction in the intake flow — but gold leads. Plain sans throughout (no serif) keeps every screen feeling like a functional, well-organized tool a person actually runs, not a decorative brochure. This direction was revised directly by Gavi from an earlier forest-green/serif draft, after live review against the Design Inspo board.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream page background (#fbfaf6), never stark white behind the whole viewport — only cards and inputs are pure white.
Gold (#f2a900) is the primary accent. Sage green and lavender are secondary/tertiary accents with specific, narrow jobs.
No serif anywhere. Rubik for all headings and body text; Google Sans reserved solely for the literal Gavi411 wordmark.
Everything interactive (buttons, chips) is a full pill; inputs/selects use the large-rounded (20px) card radius, not a pill.
Cards carry a soft ambient shadow and a hairline border, not a hard drop shadow.
A full dark palette exists (manual toggle over prefers-color-scheme), not just a light-only system.

rules.name: The One Lead Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent used for general-purpose primary actions. Sage green and lavender are reserved for their two specific, already-assigned jobs (intake Submit / Back) — don't reach for them as a second brand color option elsewhere.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode-Is-Real Rule
rules.body: Every color token has a confirmed dark-mode value. New colors need a dark counterpart before shipping, not just a light one.

rules.name: The Pill-Is-For-Actions Rule
rules.body: A pill radius means click this to do something (button, chip, icon button). Inputs, selects, and containers are never pills — they use the 20px card radius instead.

dos: Do keep the page background cream (#fbfaf6 / dark #17181a) and reserve the surface-white token for cards, inputs, and modals only.
Do use Rubik for everything except the literal wordmark, which uses Google Sans.
Do make every actionable trigger (button, chip, icon button) a full pill; every input, select, card, and modal a 20px-radius surface — never a pill input.
Do keep gold as the one general-purpose accent — reach for sage green or lavender only for their specific, already-assigned jobs.
Do give every new color token both a light and a dark value before shipping it.
donts: Don't reintroduce a serif headline font — tried once, explicitly reverted by Gavi after live review.
Don't make deep forest green the primary accent — an earlier, since-corrected direction; gold leads now.
Don't give an input, select, or any container a pill radius — pills are for actionable triggers only.
Don't introduce the purple/lavender gradient look seen in some inspo images — off-brand, dating/social-app category noise.
Don't add a UI component library or CSS-in-JS dependency — plain CSS + custom properties by project convention (Ponytail/YAGNI).
Don't apply logical/bidi CSS properties system-wide — UI chrome is English/LTR only; bidi handling is scoped to specific freeform text fields.
